sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fitness Biometric Tracking and Wellness Telemetry Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law-dominant corporate statute modeled on Delaware law, with customary law elements in land and personal matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (economic and investment facilitation provisions)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (multilateral trade and investment agreement)
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation avoidance agreement of broad application is in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Beneficial Ownership (Register) Regulations 2020; Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended); Registered Agents Act 2017; Office of the Registrar of Corporations practices; Marshall Islands National Sanctions and Proliferation Financing Regulations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport and proof of identity for each director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths in the country of issue
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing country is a party; otherwise consular legalization through nearest Republic of the Marshall Islands embassy or consular services delegated to a U.S. Embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or licensed corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in the issuing jurisdiction; if issued by a registered agent, notarization and apostille may be required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Consent to Act form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the Marshall Islands only; apostille not required unless executed outside the jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML due diligence questionnaire and source of wealth statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature; Hague Apostille or consular legalization if the subscriber executes outside the Marshall Islands and the receiving agent so requires

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated and manual screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, and Marshall Islands domestic designated-persons lists. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and senior management approval. Negative media checks and continuous client risk monitoring are required at formation and on an ongoing basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations - online Corporate Registry name search and reservation system (access through licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin script in English; non-English or non-Latin script names require a certified transliteration into the Latin alphabet. Names must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and must not be identical or confusingly similar. The corporate name may include Arabic numerals and punctuation, but must comply with the Business Corporations Act section 16 requirements.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its registered agent must file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days of notice, stating the grounds of distinctiveness and supplying any supporting evidence of prior use or goodwill. The Registrar must issue a reasoned decision within 10 business days. Any aggrieved applicant may file a further judicial appeal in the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 21 days of the adverse administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for non-resident digital health app companies, provided that a licensed registered agent maintains a physical registered office in the Marshall Islands and accepts service of process at all times. The company may not hold itself out as maintaining an operational physical office in-country. A virtual office at the registered agent's address is sufficient for this low-risk intangibles business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 3-5% annual probability for a low-risk, license-free digital application), increased only if adverse media, high-risk payment allegations, or unusual transaction patterns trigger an AML/CFT inspection by the Financial Intelligence Unit or Registrar.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance search and statutory availability check
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (collected via licensed registered agent)
Office of the Registrar of Corporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation document preparation, corporate governance review, and counsel on ISIC 6201 scope
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm / licensed corporate service provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent acceptance and first-year registered office service
Notarization and apostille / consular legalization of identity and due diligence documents (2 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public / competent apostille authority (varies by home jurisdiction)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening, and risk assessment
Government incorporation filing fee for Business Corporation (non-resident, exempt)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Expedited processing and courier of apostilled documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (if any) and service charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Marshall Islands Revised Code Title 27 — provisions governing Articles of Incorporation, registered office and registered agent, initial directors, bylaws, and subscription for shares; Income Tax Act 1988 (as amended), Section 10(a) — income exemption for non-resident domestic corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro Atoll), acting through licensed registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (including the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation tax-exempt status designation).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum authorized or paid-up capital is required. The Corporation may issue no-par shares for any lawful consideration determined by the board. No escrow bank account is mandated; the sole shareholder may satisfy the subscription through nominal cash contribution or contribution of digital/software intellectual property, recorded in the first board resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription for shares by the sole shareholder in the authorized no-par share capital is approved, and the President and Secretary are authorized to issue certificates upon full payment of the subscription consideration. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation be established at the registered agent's office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent is retained to accept service of process. RESOLVED, that [President], [Secretary], and [Treasurer] are appointed as officers, each to serve until successors are elected. The officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute Apple IAP and Google Play Billing merchant agreements, and execute all documents for the Corporation's non-resident exempt digital health operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Corporate Name Registry Desk (Majuro; online portal submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the RMI corporate registry portal. Confirm the proposed name contains a permitted corporate suffix (Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or abbreviation), is not identical or deceptively similar to any name on the active register, and is not misleading for a digital health software business. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the name reservation certificate valid for 30 days. Proceed to Articles of Incorporation drafting within the validity window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or is on reservation for a prior applicant, submit a written request for reconsideration with three alternate names to the Registrar. The Registrar must respond within five business days, and a corrected reservation may be filed without penalty if lodged within the original validity period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Registered Agent Licensing Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a Registered Agent Consent with an RMI-licensed registered agent maintaining a physical office in Majuro. The agent will act as the Corporation's registered office for service of process, maintain statutory records, and receive annual compliance renewal notices. File the agent's signed consent concurrently with the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Consent Form (signed and notarized)
Proof of the agent's current RMI license
Registered office address confirmation in Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the consent is defective or the agent's license is not current, obtain a re-executed consent or appoint a substitute agent by filing a Statement of Change of Registered Agent. No lapse in registered agent coverage is permitted, and the Registrar will note the correction without restarting the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Counsel / Notary Public, with subsequent acceptance by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act, including: the corporate name; the registered agent and registered office address; the authorized share capital (e.g., 50,000 no-par value shares); the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation tax-exempt designation; the permitted business purpose covering ISIC 6201 digital health application development; and incorporator signatures. Execute in counterpart or electronically where permitted; notarize incorporator signatures and obtain an apostille if required for banking or merchant onboarding.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies a drafting defect, such as an impermissible purpose clause, file corrected Articles with a Covering Letter of Correction. A correction filing fee may apply, and the statutory review period restarts from the date of the corrected lodgment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Corporations Filing Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation together with the registered agent consent, the non-resident designation, and proof of payment of the USD 100 state filing fee. Submit electronically through the registry portal or deliver physically to the Majuro office. The Registrar will examine, enter into the register, file the Articles, and issue the Certificate of Incorporation. Obtain certified copies for bank account and merchant account KYC. Expedited 24-hour review is available for an additional fee.
required_dossiers: Filing fee wire or remittance advice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected for missing documents or fee discrepancy, cure the defect by refiling the corrected document and adjusting the remittance within 10 business days. A minor defect will not render the application abandoned if timely cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Organizational Meeting and Adoption of Governance Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (corporate record maintained in the statutory minute book; not filed with the Registrar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the incorporator-designated board, or obtain a unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting. Approve the Bylaws; approve the subscription of shares and issuance of share certificates to the sole shareholder; designate the registered office as the principal administrative office; appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; adopt the banking resolution and the merchant resolution authorizing Apple IAP and Google Play Billing accounts.
required_dossiers: Unanimous Written Consent or Minutes of the First Board Meeting
Share subscription list and share certificates
Banking resolution and merchant account resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any consent is missing a signature, obtain ratification by written consent of the majority of directors. The ratification is recorded as a minute addendum and does not require re-filing with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Non-Resident Tax-Exempt Status Confirmation and Annual Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Revenue and Taxation, Ministry of Finance; Office of the Registrar of Corporations (annual registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation exemption declaration with the Bureau of Revenue and Taxation confirming the absence of RMI-source income and the absence of business activity within the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Obtain the Certificate of Exempt Status confirming the zero-percent income tax regime. Register for the annual report obligation and pay the annual registration fee to the Registrar. Complete bank account opening and platform payout onboarding for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing.
required_dossiers: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation exemption declaration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Bureau of Revenue and Taxation requests additional evidence of non-residence, provide an affidavit from the registered agent and a bank confirmation of the foreign bank account. Any adverse assessment is appealable to the Commissioner of Revenue within 30 days of notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Non-Resident Digital Enterprise Authorization Unit, with oversight by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade for any incidental foreign investment business license requirement.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Non-Resident Digital Enterprise Operating Authorization (Exempt Industrial Class — ISIC 6201 / NAICS 511210 Digital Health and Fitness Application Software).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 — Exempt from Full EIA (software-only activity; no physical manufacturing facility, no land disturbance, and no point-source discharge in the Republic of the Marshall Islands).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to server-only operations. If the Corporation establishes a local office or data center, wastewater discharge must comply with RMI EPA Clean Water Act thresholds (BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L; TSS not exceeding 30 mg/L; pH 6.5–8.5); VOC emissions must remain below 1.5 tonnes per year; and all e-waste handling must conform to the Basel Convention and SPREP requirements, requiring prior EPA consent for any regulated e-waste export.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Majuro Fire Department for the registered office or serviced office premises; structural load inspection certificate for the office floor area; occupational workplace clearance confirming a non-hazardous office environment with accessible egress, emergency evacuation plan, and first-aid provisions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate registration and annual fee administration is handled by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations. No integrated national online tax filing portal is operative for non-resident business corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Marshall Islands does not operate a general income tax or VAT system for non-resident business corporations, and no separate TIN or VAT ID is required for a Marshall Islands Business Corporation (Non-Resident). The foreign entity obtains its corporate identity through the Registrar of Corporations by filing Articles of Incorporation and receiving a Registration Certificate. If a tax identification-style reference is required by a foreign bank or intermediary, the corporation may request a Certificate of Good Standing / Tax Status from the Revenue and Taxation Division, supported by its Registration Certificate and registered agent details.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — a non-resident Business Corporation is expressly exempt from Marshall Islands income, withholding, gross revenue, and other national taxes under the Business Corporations Act and applicable non-resident corporation legislation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. The Marshall Islands has no check-the-box entity classification election and no hybrid mismatch election mechanism. The tax status of a non-resident Business Corporation is fixed by statute and is not elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — the Republic of the Marshall Islands does not impose VAT, GST, sales and use tax, or any comparable general indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Because RMI uses the United States Dollar as legal tender, any analogous customs importer licensing threshold would be denominated in USD, but no indirect tax registration obligation is triggered by supply turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or government clearance API mandate is imposed by the Marshall Islands tax administration. Standard commercial invoicing is sufficient.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because the Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST levy. Exports of goods and offshore services, including digital health and fitness app tracker services, are outside the scope of RMI indirect taxation; there is therefore no 0% rated export supply and no statutory export refund claim mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No VAT export zero-rating refund bundle is prescribed or required in the Marshall Islands.
Customs export declaration/outward manifest retained where tangible goods are physically exported from the RMI.
Bill of lading or air waybill retained where applicable for physical export movements.
Commercial invoice or service contract for the digital health fitness application services.
Inward remittance evidence maintained for corporate record-keeping purposes, not as a condition for any indirect tax refund.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: As there is no zero-rating or refund regime, no fraudulent export zero-rating clawback can arise. However, false or fraudulent customs declarations are subject to penalties under Marshall Islands customs regulations, including monetary fines, seizure, and forfeiture. Knowingly providing false information to the Registrar of Corporations or the Revenue and Taxation Division may also result in imposition of penalties, cancellation of benefits, or loss of the non-resident tax exempt status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain a domestic central bank or separate foreign-exchange administration. Monetary authority for the US Dollar, which is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, effectively rests with the United States Federal Reserve. Banking prudential regulation is administered by the Banking Commissioner within the Ministry of Finance under the Banking Act 1980; AML/CFT supervision is exercised by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). Corporate registry and Business Corporations Act functions sit with the Registrar of Corporations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility on both current and capital account. RMI imposes no exchange controls, no advance approval requirements, and no reporting gates on inward or outward USD remittances. A non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) deriving no RMI-source income is tax-exempt under the territorial Income Tax Act and faces no RMI withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or management fees. Dividend and profit repatriation is unrestricted in law; practical friction arises only from foreign correspondent bank compliance perception and the completeness of the entity's documentary evidence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender rule, holding period, or mandatory conversion ratio applies. Digital export proceeds from Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and other app-store settlements may be retained indefinitely in USD, converted into any foreign currency, or transferred offshore at treasury discretion without RMI central bank approval. Invoices and payment evidence must be retained under general Banking Act record-keeping obligations but no conversion timeline is prescribed.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the Federated States of Micronesia (Bank of FSM, Majuro Agency)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. RMI law contains no electronic-money-institution or fintech charter, and no non-USD domestic clearing system exists because the US Dollar is the exclusive settlement currency. Offshore EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, or Currencycloud may technically onboard an MH_BC, but they classify an RMI-registered entity in a higher perceived-risk cohort and frequently impose enhanced due diligence, low transaction caps, restricted virtual-account functionality, and termination risk. Recommended architecture: activate the primary operating and reserve accounts at an RMI-licensed bank with a strong US correspondent, or at a US bank accepting the RMI entity under FATCA NFFE status; use an EMI only as a secondary collection rail for app-store proceeds and as a SEPA disbursement channel after the primary account is operational.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is the de facto standard at RMI-licensed banks: at least one director or a fully authorized signatory must appear at the Majuro branch for the initial interview and biometric verification. Fully remote opening is not a settled practice, although a bank may accept an apostilled certified-copy bundle comprising the certificate of incorporation, articles, director passports, and power of attorney when the applicant is introduced by a licensed RMI Registered Agent and passes a live video interview and source-of-funds review. Foreign-licensed banks apply the head-office KYC standard, which reinforces the documentary burden rather than relaxing it.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) identity is not reconcilable with the licensed Registered Agent's master files.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current certificate of good standing; certified chain-of-ownership chart identifying every 25% or greater UBO; certified register of shareholders and directors; passport and proof of address for each UBO; apostilled Registered Agent client take-on file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder capital injections display no verifiable, arm's-length source of lawful wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved subscription agreement and share register; capital contribution ledger; bank reference letters from each contributing shareholder's institution; six months of personal, venture-fund, or corporate statements; sworn source-of-wealth declaration; CPA-reviewed financial statements where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Stateless corporate profile comprising an RMI entity with no foreign tax residence triggers substance and tax-motive red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI non-resident status letter from the Ministry of Finance; territorial-tax exemption memorandum from a licensed international tax adviser; board resolution documenting the legitimate treasury and billing function of the MH_BC within the fitness application group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency micro-transactions flowing from app stores create an unusual transaction profile potentially consistent with mule-payment or payment-benefit abuse typologies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple Developer Program and Google Play Developer Program agreements; monthly payout statements reconciled against the in-app subscription database; transaction-monitoring exception log with quarterly AML compliance sign-off; written chargeback, refund, and cancellation policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Consumer biometric wellness data and unrestricted global user access raise sanctions and data-protection ambiguity during bank underwriting.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country-level blocking list configured across all storefront territories; OFAC-compliant sanctions screening output covering counterparties and signatories; GDPR and CCPA/CPRA compliance register with current privacy policy; independent application penetration-test certificate available for technology risk review.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity is injected in USD by SWIFT MT103 or through a US correspondent Fedwire transfer. The remittance must identify the legal name MH_BC, the RMI Business Corporation registration number, and the governing subscription agreement, with the SWIFT remittance-information field citing the ISO purpose code CAPL (capital payment). Funds clear at the New York correspondent into a segregated Capital Escrow Account and are reclassified to the Operational Account only after the bank's compliance release. The bank concurrently requires a FATCA Form W-8BEN-E evidencing NFFE status, confirmation of the Registered Agent, the entity ID MH_BC, and a board resolution naming treasury signatories. No RMI exchange-control approval is triggered because the USD is legal tender and no conversion step occurs. Storefront consumer proceeds from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing arrive as separate monthly payouts and are posted directly to the Operational Account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Vendor disbursements for cloud hosting, legal, marketing, and localization services are cleared in USD by SWIFT MT103 through the RMI bank's US correspondent, using the beneficiary ABA routing and account number. Commercial Letters of Credit are not applicable to the intangible digital-health service model and are reserved only for a future physical-goods procurement line. For efficiency, treasury should maintain an intra-US ACH batch rail for recurring domestic suppliers and a SEPA Instant virtual account for EUR-denominated vendor payments via the secondary EMI rail. All outbound payments must carry a business justification code, the ISIC 6201 scope reference, and an invoice identifier to satisfy correspondent-bank transparency expectations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR and USD/GBP FX forward contracts executed under ISDA 2002 with a US-regulated bank or prime brokerage
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for exotic currencies arising from multi-geo app-store settlements where no reliable onshore deliverable market exists
Cross-currency swaps (EUR-USD and GBP-USD) matched to material non-USD cloud infrastructure or marketing commitments
Vanilla FX options purchased on a premium-payment basis for downside protection on AUD, NZD, and CAD contractor and localization exposures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (submitted through licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based filing due on or before the last day of the month of incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 200 after the statutory due date; continued non-filing triggers administrative revocation and corporate strike-off after approximately three months of delinquency

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for non-resident business corporations; audit is required only if corporate constitutional documents mandate it or shareholders representing at least 10% of outstanding shares request one
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP permitted; no statutory accounting framework is imposed on tax-exempt non-resident business corporations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation filing is required under Marshall Islands law; the annual report must state current directors, officers, and shareholders, and share transfer changes are recorded in the register of members; no public UBO register exists

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary certified audit typically USD 3,000–USD 8,000 for a small digital health app entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (non-resident domestic Business Corporation - full exemption from corporate income tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate 0%. Business Corporations Act Section 108 exempts a non-resident domestic corporation from all Marshall Islands taxes except the annual franchise tax. No national income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax and no property tax are imposed. The Business Privilege Tax (generally 3% of gross revenues) applies only to business activity conducted inside the Marshall Islands; app subscription and in-app purchase revenue sourced through Apple IAP / Google Play Billing is foreign-source and outside the BPT net. Investment incentive certificates exist only for on-island physical ventures and are not material to this structure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax Statement (Business Corporations Act Sections 106-108), filed through the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations electronic filing portal; filing is performed by the licensed registered agent as statutory filer. No corporate income tax return exists because no CIT is levied.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (single combined filing containing the annual report and franchise tax payment).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due annually by the corporation's incorporation anniversary (deadline is the end of the anniversary month as invoiced by the licensed registered agent; dates are set to the anniversary rather than a fixed calendar date such as 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the corporation as stated in the articles of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate of incorporation; no trade names or variants may be substituted.
Use the permanent file number assigned by the Registrar; typographical errors delay filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and street address of the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A current registered agent is mandatory at all times; a non-resident corporation cannot self-represent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the registered agent's physical office in Majuro; a post office box is not acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all incumbent directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide residential or service addresses of non-resident directors; no Marshall Islands residency is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business or head office outside the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the actual operating address (e.g., the developer or group headquarters); this supports the non-resident exemption claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, classes of shares, and issued share numbers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital applies; disclose nominal share capital and any issued subscription shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident domestic corporation status (operative tax exemption statement).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Formally affirm that no business is transacted within the Marshall Islands and that no Marshall Islands-source income is derived; this declaration activates the exemption under Section 108.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature, capacity and date of the authorized signatory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Execution may be delegated to the registered agent under a written power of attorney; electronic signature is accepted by the portal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty per the Registrar's published fee schedule (generally a flat late fee plus monthly accrual until filed). Continued default triggers loss of Good Standing, suspension of the ability to obtain certificates or effect filings, and administrative dissolution after a statutory default period. Restoration requires settlement of all arrears, penalties and a reinstatement fee. A struck-off exempt BC loses the tax exemption before it can be reinstated.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a Business Corporation).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable; the Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and issues no CIT tax residence certificates. Where a foreign jurisdiction requires proof of RMI tax status, the entity requests a Certificate of Good Standing and a non-resident exemption certificate from the Registrar; no simultaneous domestic tax clearance is required because no CIT risk arises at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest paid by an RMI Business Corporation to non-residents is 0%. Treaty-reduced rates: not applicable (no DTA network; the 0% domestic rate already provides full source-state relief).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands has no domestic transfer pricing legislation, no arm's length codification, and no Local File / Master File thresholds. The functional currency is the US dollar. For the health fitness app, arm's length pricing of the app IP and intercompany subscription flows remains relevant only to the tax authorities of the beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI economic substance regime (aligned to OECD/EU standards) applies to a BC carrying on a relevant activity as a tax resident entity. IP holding and exploitation is an in-scope category, but a non-resident BC that files the non-resident declaration, is tax resident in another jurisdiction, and has no RMI management, employees, premises or expenditure is outside the local substance test. If the entity is characterized as RMI tax resident, it must satisfy the directed-and-managed test and maintain adequate staff and spending in the Marshall Islands, which is commercially unviable for a digital health app; the clean structure therefore preserves non-resident status and avoids the substance burden.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying non-resident exempt status while carrying on business in the Marshall Islands, earning Marshall Islands-source revenue, or using the exempt RMI BC to conceal the beneficial owner's home-jurisdiction tax obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the Section 108 exemption, retroactive assessment of Business Privilege Tax at the general gross-receipts rate with surcharges, monetary fines under the Business Privilege Tax Act and the Criminal Code, and administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers signing a false declaration are joint and severally liable for the assessed tax and penalties; deliberate misrepresentation is a criminal offense carrying imprisonment and personal asset recovery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a nominee-owned empty vehicle with no board governance, no commercial rationale, and no foreign presence in the jurisdiction of claimed tax residence, while exploiting the RMI exemption or engaging in an in-scope relevant activity without local substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed and daily default penalties under the economic substance legislation, mandatory exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, and deregistration from the corporate register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines for failure to file substance declarations and may be subjected to travel bans and imprisonment for non-compliance with enforcement orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deploying the BC and its app payment rails (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing) without AML risk-based due diligence on the founder, or using the RMI corporate account to launder digital app revenue through shell intermediates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines and asset forfeiture under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2012; revocation of intermediation approvals for the registered agent; freezing orders issued by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and knowing beneficiaries are exposed to criminal money-laundering prosecution and custodial sentences where the corporate entity is used as an instrument of crime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to identify and file the ultimate beneficial owner with the licensed registered agent and the central beneficial ownership register, or concealing the founding developer's controlling interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Per-offence monetary penalties plus continuing daily penalties, suspension of filing rights, and possible administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers and the registered agent may be held personally liable for a false or missing BO filing; deliberate concealment is classified as a criminal offence carrying imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring dividends to the founder while the BC is insolvent, stripping the app IP to a related party without solvency certification, or otherwise making an unauthorized distribution that impairs creditor claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The distribution is recoverable under the Business Corporations Act; the court may wind up the corporation on just and equitable grounds and impose fines for false solvency statements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable to restore the full amount of the unlawful distribution; evidence of fraud leads to civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment.
